DATES 02 Oct – 04 Oct 2026 VENUE Pragati Maidan, On-site Official Links Visit Site ↗ Page Views 220 Overview Contact Exhibitors Feed Speakers Reviews Schedule About the Event Medicall New Delhi 2026 is the 48th edition of Medicall , one of India's leading B2B exhibitions dedicated to the medical equipment, hospital supplies, healthcare technology, diagnostics, surgical equipment, and medical devices industry. The event is scheduled for 2–4 October 2026 in New Delhi , with Pragati Maidan listed as the venue for the Delhi edition. The official Medicall website describes the event as India’s Largest & No.1 Medical Equipment Exhibition . Medicall is organized by Medexpert Business Consultants Pvt. Ltd. and brings together medical equipment manufacturers, hospitals, doctors, healthcare entrepreneurs, biomedical engineers, distributors, dealers, procurement professionals, and other healthcare decision-makers. 📅 Date: 2–4 October 2026 📍 Venue: Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, India 🏢 Organizer: Medexpert Business Consultants Pvt. Ltd. 🎯 Industry: Medical Equipment, Hospital Supplies, Medical Devices, Diagnostics & Healthcare Technology 🔢 Edition: 48th Edition . Highlights Medical Equipment & Hospital Technology Medicall provides a comprehensive platform for medical equipment used in hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres, laboratories, and healthcare facilities. Major product categories include: Hospital Equipment Medical Devices Patient Monitoring Equipment ICU Equipment OT Equipment Emergency Medical Equipment Patient Care Equipment Hospital Furniture Medical Consumables. 🔬 Diagnostics & Laboratory Equipment The exhibition features technologies for diagnostics and laboratory operations, including: Diagnostic Equipment Laboratory Instruments Clinical Testing Systems Pathology Equipment Sample Processing Systems Laboratory Consumables Medical Testing Technologies. These solutions support hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, clinics, research institutions, and healthcare professionals. 🩺 Surgical & Operation Theatre Solutions Visitors can explore: Surgical Equipment Operation Theatre Systems Surgical Instruments Electrosurgical Equipment Anaesthesia Equipment OT Furniture Sterilization Systems Surgical Consumables. 🫁 ICU, Critical Care & Emergency Equipment The exhibition covers technologies including: Ventilators Patient Monitors Defibrillators Infusion Pumps ICU Equipment Emergency Care Equipment Oxygen & Respiratory Systems Critical Care Technologies. 🩻 Medical Imaging Key technologies include: X-Ray Systems Ultrasound Medical Imaging Equipment Digital Imaging Technologies Diagnostic Imaging Accessories Imaging Workflow Solutions. 🧪 Laboratory & Research Technologies Visitors can discover: Laboratory Equipment Analytical Instruments Research Equipment Laboratory Automation Testing Technologies Diagnostic Reagents Laboratory Consumables. 🦽 Rehabilitation & Mobility Equipment Medicall also provides a marketplace for: Physiotherapy Equipment Rehabilitation Systems Wheelchairs Mobility Aids Patient Transfer Equipment Home Healthcare Equipment Assistive Devices. 🏠 Home Healthcare & Patient Care The event connects buyers with products for home and continuing care, such as: Homecare Medical Devices Patient Beds Monitoring Devices Mobility Solutions Respiratory Care Elderly Care Products Personal Healthcare Equipment. 🧼 Infection Control & Sterilization Healthcare facilities can explore: Sterilizers Autoclaves Disinfection Systems Infection Control Products Medical Waste Solutions Hygiene Products Hospital Cleaning Technologies. 🧑‍💻 Digital Healthcare & Connected Technologies Medicall's wider healthcare ecosystem also creates opportunities for technologies such as: Hospital Management Software Digital Health Platforms Telemedicine Healthcare IT Connected Medical Devices Data Management Patient Information Systems Healthcare Automation. Hospital Infrastructure & Support Systems The exhibition also serves the broader hospital infrastructure market, including: Hospital Furniture Medical Gas Systems Electrical & Power Solutions HVAC Systems Modular OT Solutions Hospital Flooring Water Treatment Biomedical Waste Management Laundry & Sterilization Systems Facility Management Solutions. This makes Medicall relevant not only for medical-device buyers but also for hospitals planning new facilities, renovations, expansions, and technology upgrades . Innovation & New Healthcare Technologies Medicall provides a platform for companies launching new healthcare products and technologies. The event supports: Product Launches Technology Demonstrations Innovation Showcase Startup Participation New Medical Devices Healthcare Technology Solutions Emerging Medical Technologies. The Medicall ecosystem also includes Innovation Awards , recognizing noteworthy developments in medical technology. Seminars & Knowledge Sessions Medicall includes seminars and workshops designed to support professional learning and industry interaction. Topics can cover: Healthcare Technology Hospital Management Medical Device Innovation Clinical Technologies Healthcare Business Hospital Infrastructure Emerging Medical Solutions Industry Trends. The official Medicall website maintains a dedicated Seminars section and provides registration for seminar/workshop participation. Visitor Profile Medicall is particularly relevant to: Hospital Owners Hospital Directors Hospital Administrators Doctors Surgeons Medical Professionals Biomedical Engineers Diagnostic Centre Owners Laboratory Professionals Procurement Managers Purchase Departments Medical Equipment Dealers Distributors Healthcare Entrepreneurs Medical Device Buyers Nursing & Patient-Care Professionals. The exhibition is positioned as a B2B medical equipment marketplace connecting suppliers with healthcare buyers and decision-makers. Exhibitor Profile Companies participating in Medicall can include: Medical Equipment Manufacturers Medical Device Companies Hospital Equipment Suppliers Diagnostic Equipment Manufacturers Laboratory Equipment Companies Surgical Instrument Manufacturers ICU & Critical Care Equipment Providers Imaging Equipment Companies Rehabilitation Equipment Manufacturers Hospital Furniture Manufacturers Medical Consumables Suppliers Healthcare IT Companies Digital Health Providers Hospital Infrastructure Companies Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Support Companies. Business & Networking Opportunities Medicall provides opportunities to: 🤝 Connect with hospitals and healthcare decision-makers. 🏥 Discover equipment for new and expanding hospitals. 🔬 Source diagnostic and laboratory technologies. 🩺 Meet surgical and critical-care equipment suppliers. 📈 Develop dealer and distributor networks. 💼 Identify procurement and sourcing opportunities. 🚀 Launch new medical devices and technologies. 🌐 Connect with healthcare businesses across India. 🧑‍⚕️ Network with medical professionals and hospital administrators. Medicall Digital Platform Medicall also operates a digital discovery platform that allows buyers to browse products and exhibitors before the physical exhibition, shortlist companies, and schedule meetings . This provides continuity before, during, and after the trade show. Future Editions Medicall's current event calendar also lists: 49th Edition – Mumbai: 8–10 December 2026 50th Edition – Kolkata: 19–21 February 2027 51st Edition – Hyderabad: 2–4 April 2027. Event Snapshot Details Information Event Medicall New Delhi 2026 Edition 48th Edition Date 2–4 October 2026 Venue Pragati Maidan, New Delhi Format B2B Medical Equipment Exhibition Industry Medical Devices, Hospital Equipment & Healthcare Technology Organizer Medexpert Business Consultants Pvt. Ltd. Why Attend Medicall New Delhi 2026? ✅ Explore the latest medical equipment, devices and hospital technologies . ✅ Discover advanced diagnostic, laboratory, surgical and ICU solutions. ✅ Source equipment for hospitals, clinics, laboratories and diagnostic centres. ✅ Meet medical equipment manufacturers, distributors and technology providers. ✅ Connect with hospital administrators, doctors, biomedical engineers and procurement teams. ✅ Attend seminars and industry knowledge sessions. ✅ Discover new healthcare products, startups and innovative technologies. ✅ Explore hospital infrastructure and support solutions alongside medical devices. ✅ Build strategic supplier, distributor and procurement partnerships. ✅ Access one of India's major B2B platforms for the medical equipment industry. Medicall New Delhi 2026 is a major B2B platform for India's medical equipment and healthcare technology industry. Its combination of medical devices, diagnostics, hospital equipment, surgical technologies, critical care, rehabilitation, digital health, hospital infrastructure and industry seminars makes the 48th edition an important meeting point for healthcare buyers, manufacturers, distributors and decision-makers.
